Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing approval requirements for fluoridation of group A water systems.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fluoridation of public water systems; adding anew section to chapter 43.20 RCW; creating a new section; and declaringan emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that it is in thepublic interest that prior to the fluoridation of a group A watersystem as defined in RCW 70.119.020, the customers of the water systemor the elected local water system governing body or operator directlyresponsible to the department of health for utility operations shouldmake the final decision on the addition of fluoride to the watersystem.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The addition of fluoridation compounds to water provided by a groupA water system as defined in RCW 70.119.020 not adding fluoridationcompounds as of the effective date of this act shall be permitted onlyupon an affirmative vote of: (1) The water system's customers; or p. 1 SSB 5764 (2) The water system's elected local governing body or operatordirectly responsible to the department for utility operations.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
